terms.definition: Telegram-based food discovery and eating-planning assistant.
Main launcher for Soleat features inside Telegram.
Search experience for cuisines, dishes, cooking methods, filters, and related food discovery.
A result card representing an eatery or food-place option.
Planning and saved-card space where copied eatery cards can be organised into catch-all, cabinets, drawers, and cards.
Temporary holding area where copied eatery cards land first.
A larger Sketchbook plan, such as a trip, event, outing, or food trail.
A section inside a cabinet, often representing a time slot, day, route segment, or event segment.
Singapore station-exit information used for practical walking and location planning.
Nearby bus stop and bus arrival context where available.
Singapore car park context and availability where available.
Food places surfaced from recognised or curated sources.
Lesser-known food-place suggestions that may be useful for discovery.
Dish or cuisine suggestion intended to help a user choose something meaningful, not a generic category.
